title: Two Tugs Dockside
content: Two hardworking tugboats wait at dockside in this small oil study.Two Tugs,oil on panel, 6 x 8 inches, plein-airOne is still running its engine, judging from the puff of smoke. Hazy sunshine comes in from the left, allowing me to lose the edges in the lower right of the picture. The pinkish priming color peeks through in a few places, but the rest is mostly gray.
